claims.avoid: Instant processing; the original operations took minutes. Only documents.read has connector receipt recorded=true.

claims.strength: real local semantic reports plus deterministic invariant tests. Selected screenshot is a controlled-model semantic-risk block, not live detection proof.

metrics_policy: Keep numerical test/quality/performance metrics out of the song. Current all-local artifact is failed; contract is passed but is not full release acceptance. These files are actively changing.
language: User explicitly requests this additional musical variant in Polish; canonical English material remains separate.
footage_label_policy: Use Demo for synthetic local workflow. Use Demo / test kontrolowany for controlled-model redaction, semantic block and approval. Describe all screen captures as recorded, not live execution.

palette.observed: Near-black/charcoal background, lime primary action and status accent, white main text, muted secondary copy.
palette.fit: The palette matches a technical control console and links allowed states, navigation and the product mark. Existing video benefits from high contrast.
palette.concrete_improvement: For the film, crop detail dialogs to the right panel and use large high-contrast lyrics. Do not color-grade UI heavily or recolor the shared app.

source_constraints: No claims of customer adoption, savings, certification, perfect detection, instant local inference or passed complete release.
